My main interest is deep learning. In my current research, I develop predictive and generative models for RNA structure, with a focus on evaluation, structural diversity, and uncertainty.

I trained as a physicist and now work on problems that bring machine learning and bioinformatics together.

## Current Focus

::: {.work-grid}
::: {.work-item}
### [Deep Learning for RNA Structure](research.qmd)

I develop neural models for RNA secondary structure and study how their performance changes across datasets, sequence similarities, and RNA families.
:::

::: {.work-item}
### [Generative Modeling](research.qmd#generating-rna-structural-ensembles)

I use conditional discrete diffusion models to sample multiple plausible structures and represent diversity beyond a single prediction.
:::

::: {.work-item}
### [Evaluation and Generalization](research.qmd#evaluating-generalization-in-rna-prediction)

I compare models under family-aware and sequence-similarity evaluation to understand when they generalize to less familiar examples.
:::
:::
